description: Read a hotel cashback claim made with the user's haggl ID: its status and what comes next.
name: haggl_hotel_cashback_get

rate_pct.description: Share of the booking total, in percent.

hotel.description: The hotel, as read from the booking.

status.description: awaiting_stay, due (paid within 2 business days), paid or void.

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.
